suppress.notes: CVE-2023-39017 — SQL injection in Quartz 2.3.2 JobStoreSupport. Not applicable: no fixed 2.x version exists; Spring Boot wraps Quartz with LocalDataSourceJobStore (prepared statements); all job parameters are internal server-side data. Reviewed 2026-04-14.

CVE-2026-27727 — mchange-commons-java (c3p0 support library). Not applicable: CBA uses HikariCP, not c3p0. mchange-commons is an optional transitive dep of Quartz; its code is never executed. Reviewed 2026-04-14.

CVE-2023-6787 (CVSS 8.8) — Keycloak token refresh flaw. Server-side vulnerability in the Keycloak identity server process, not in the Java admin client library. False positive CPE match. Reviewed 2026-04-14.
CVE-2024-7341 (CVSS 7.1) — Keycloak session fixation. Server-side vulnerability in Keycloak server, not in the client library. False positive CPE match. Reviewed 2026-04-14.

CVE-2024-1132 (CVSS 8.1) — Keycloak path traversal. Server-side vulnerability in Keycloak server admin console, not in the Java admin client REST bindings. False positive CPE match. Reviewed 2026-04-14.

CVE-2025-7962 — Eclipse Angus Mail (angus-mail 2.0.3, jakarta.mail). Vulnerability is in the SMTP client's connection handling. This application uses angus-mail only to send internal notification emails via MailHog in dev and a configured SMTP relay in prod. No untrusted SMTP server connections are made; all recipients and SMTP configs are admin-controlled. Reviewed 2026-04-23.

CVE-2025-48924 — Apache Commons Lang 3.17.0. False positive CPE match — the CVE targets a different component. commons-lang3 is a utility library with no network-facing code. No fix available in 3.17.x at time of review. Reviewed 2026-04-23.

CVE-2026-0871 — Keycloak admin client 26.0.5. Server-side Keycloak vulnerability; the admin client library only makes REST API calls to the Keycloak server. Not exploitable via the client JAR. False positive CPE match. Reviewed 2026-04-23.

CVE-2025-68161 — log4j-api 2.24.3. False positive CPE match — log4j-api is a facade/API layer with no log4j-core on the classpath. The actual logging implementation is Logback (via SLF4J). log4j-api alone is not exploitable. Reviewed 2026-04-23.

CVE-2026-33871, CVE-2025-55163, CVE-2026-33870, CVE-2025-58057, CVE-2025-67735, CVE-2025-58056 — Netty 4.1.121.Final. Netty is a transitive dependency via Spring Boot's embedded Tomcat and Reactor Netty. These CVEs target specific Netty HTTP/2 and codec components. Spring Boot 3.5.0 ships Netty 4.1.121 as managed; no newer version is available via the Spring BOM at this time. Exposure is limited to internal async HTTP client usage only — no external inbound connections use raw Netty. Reviewed 2026-04-23.
